_purpose: Module 101C (semantic intake / L2 intent classifier) reads ALL of its tunables from this file. No category vocabulary, threshold or clarify wording may appear in module_101c_semantic_intake.py. The closed category set itself comes from intake_classifier.json (default_planning_mode_by_category minus hard_block_categories) so there is exactly ONE source of truth for what categories exist.

category_descriptions.capability_boundary: User asks whether/how the agent can touch, control or operate their computer, mouse, keyboard or screen (a meta question about capability, not a concrete task)
category_descriptions.identity_capability: User asks who/what the agent is, or what it can do in general
category_descriptions.patent_legal_draft: Draft or review a patent, contract, NDA, agreement or other legal document
category_descriptions.research_report: Search the web / gather sources first, then write a summary or report with citations
category_descriptions.file_delete: Delete, remove or clean up specific files or folders
category_descriptions.file_write: Save, store or write content into a file
category_descriptions.file_read: Open, read or view the contents of an existing file
category_descriptions.report_generation: Write a report, summary or structured prose document (no explicit web research requested)
category_descriptions.office_doc_generation: Produce a Word/PowerPoint/Excel deliverable (docx, pptx, xlsx, slides, spreadsheet)
category_descriptions.image_generation: Generate, draw or render a picture or image
category_descriptions.source_code_edit: Modify, refactor or patch source code
category_descriptions.desktop_org: Organize, list, move or tidy files on the desktop or in folders
category_descriptions.external_email: Compose or send an email to someone
category_descriptions.external_publish: Publish, upload or post content to an external/public destination
category_descriptions.shell_command: Run a shell / terminal / command-line command
category_descriptions.gui_automation: Click, type, press keys, scroll or take screenshots via GUI automation

clarify_templates.cjk: 我想先确认一下你的需求，避免答非所问：你是希望我生成某种文件或报告、查资料、整理文件，还是别的？请再说得具体一点。
clarify_templates.default: Before I act, I want to make sure I understand. Could you describe more specifically what you'd like me to do — for example produce a document, look something up, or organize files?
